title: Locally adaptive step sizes for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.16506v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exact reversible locally adaptive step sizes are introduced by Bou-Rabee et al. (2026) in the context of the No-U-Turn Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) sampler for the purpose of high performance HMC sampling in challenging target distributions. This paper carefully explains and illustrates the locally adaptive step size procedure under more general assumptions. Alternative error measures are introduced with the aim of further enhancing MCMC performance by reducing the prevalence of reversibility failure rejections. In addition, the paper shows how to introduce the locally adaptive step sizes also within standard HMC and Metropolis-corrected kinetic Langevin/generalized HMC (GHMC). Finally, a numerical study of the relative merits of the proposed error measures in the context of different Hamiltonian flow-based MCMC methods is provided.

translated_title: 哈密顿蒙特卡洛方法的局部自适应步长
translated_abstract: Bou-Rabee等人（2026）在无掉头哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）采样器的背景下引入了精确可逆的局部自适应步长，目的是在具有挑战性的目标分布中实现高性能的HMC采样。本文在更一般的假设下仔细解释并举例说明了局部自适应步长程序。文章引入了替代的误差度量，旨在通过降低可逆性失败拒绝的发生率来进一步提升MCMC性能。此外，本文还展示了如何在标准HMC以及经Metropolis校正的动力学Langevin/广义HMC（GHMC）中引入局部自适应步长。最后，本文提供了在不同基于哈密顿流的MCMC方法背景下，对所提出的误差度量的相对优点的数值研究。
tldr: 本文在更一般的假设下阐释了HMC采样中的精确可逆局部自适应步长方法，提出了减少可逆性失败拒绝的替代误差度量，并将该技术扩展应用到标准HMC以及Metropolis校正的动力学Langevin/广义HMC（GHMC）方法中。
en_tdlr: This paper explains locally adaptive step sizes for HMC under more general assumptions, introduces alternative error measures to reduce reversibility failure rejections, and extends the technique to standard HMC and Metropolis-corrected kinetic Langevin/generalized HMC (GHMC) methods.
